body.name: Hthr
body.construction: For normalized tables \(A,B\) and a chosen \((c,d)\in F(A,B)\), set \(n_{00}=c\), \(n_{01}=a-c\), \(n_{10}=b-c\), and \(n_{11}=d\). For each \((i,j)\in D^2\), set \(t_{ij}=n_{ij}/w_{ij}\) when \(w_{ij}>0\), and set \(t_{ij}=0\) when \(w_{ij}=0\). Set \(\gamma_A=A(1,1)/(1-p)\) when \(1-p>0\) and \(\gamma_A=0\) otherwise; set \(\gamma_B=B(1,1)/(1-r)\) when \(1-r>0\) and \(\gamma_B=0\) otherwise. Define \(h(x,z,u,v)\) to be \(t_{uv}\), \(\gamma_A\), \(\gamma_B\), or \(1/2\) according as \((x,z)\) equals \((0,0)\), \((1,0)\), \((0,1)\), or \((1,1)\). Order the distinct values of \(\{t_{00},t_{01},t_{10},t_{11},\gamma_A,\gamma_B,1/2,0,1\}\) as \(0=\lambda_0<\cdots<\lambda_m=1\); give the private root \(W0\) the law \(P(W0=k)=\lambda_k-\lambda_{k-1}\) on \(\{1,\ldots,m\}\); and define \(fY(x,z,u,v,k)=\mathbf 1\{\lambda_k\le h(x,z,u,v)\}\). Take independent \(D\)-valued roots \(U0,V0\) with \(P(U0=0)=p\), \(P(V0=0)=r\), and set \(fX(u)=u\), \(fZ(v)=v\).
